descriptions.tsonnet_c30_record_80207b30: Flushes queued records when the optional service object and its enable word are set, optionally joins the data with a trailing text in a stack buffer, then forwards the record id (low 15 bits), data and length to the service object's third virtual slot if it exists; the service object and field meanings are inferred. The length sum and stack allocation are unvalidated for arbitrary inputs.
